propositions: Changing a ticket's type silently replays a stale plan-review verdict computed under different criteria, with no re-run when the reuse paths find an identical material fingerprint and base SHA.
Type gates scoring in multiple code paths (bug tier, exemptions, branches), so a plan that passes as 'bug' (exempt) incorrectly keeps that pass when retyped to 'task' (not exempt).
Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) compare material fingerprint and code SHA but never compare the stored ticket_type against the current type.

The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so no schema change is needed; the fix reads the stored type and returns None (fail open for reuse) when stored and current types differ and both are truthy.
Sidecars written before this change or with empty type are still eligible for reuse, avoiding mass invalidation of all existing attestations.
End-to-end verification confirmed: retype from task to bug now triggers a fresh pydantic_ai run instead of replaying the stale verdict.
